title: SIGIL: Compiling Agent Skills into Typed Harnesses
exact_task: Compile prose SKILL.md procedures into typed executable agent harnesses and test whether mandated procedure execution improves versus prose consumption.
model_scale: gpt-4o and gpt-5 via OpenAI APIs; nine runs per skill per arm per model
runtime: AG-IR; deterministic lowering to Jac/OSP harness; code-owned gates plus model-owned typed operations
baselines: Prose SKILL.md in ReAct loop vs compiled harness; same authoring model/interface in both arms
data: 30 skills across document/tooling, software-process, governance/compliance families; three process-scenario tasks per skill; three repeats
evaluation: Applicable-Mandate Compliance; full-procedure completion; token cost; model capability comparison
distinction_from_flagship: Directly occupies typed compiler/runtime boundary, model-vs-code ownership, source provenance and causal prose-vs-compiled enforcement. It does not evaluate a fixed small renderer consuming an authoritative supported/refuted/unknown/conflicting semantic-result frame, nor no-conclusion/answer-copying controls.

title: SkillSmith: Compiling Agent Skills into Boundary-Guided Runtime Interfaces
exact_task: Compile heterogeneous agent skill packages offline into minimal executable boundary contracts and measure runtime cost/correctness across tasks, models and harnesses.
model_scale: Main runtime GPT-5.5; cross-model GPT-5.5, Claude Opus 4.7, DeepSeek V4 Flash, Qwen3.6 35B A3B; stronger-model artifact reuse evaluated
runtime: Boundary-first compiler; typed executable operators/policies/validation/fallback; shared runtime; compiled artifacts
baselines: Raw-Skills; SkVM compiled skills; no-skills as runtime context; paired same runtime model/provider/tool environment
data: SkillsBench checkout: 87 runnable tasks, 227 task-local skill packages; seven verified representative tasks; five runs per condition
evaluation: Deterministic SkillsBench task success; tokens; calls/iterations; end-to-end latency; cost proxy; path consistency; failure localization
distinction_from_flagship: Occupies offline compiler-runtime reuse by smaller/cheaper models and executable boundary contracts. It does not preserve a four-state strict epistemic result contract or isolate structured-no-conclusion and answer-copying controls under a fixed small-model causal design.
evidence: arXiv:2605.15215v1 PDF §§4.1-4.4,B.3; text lines 368-447,468-491,799-860 retrieved 2026-08-07; screenshot endpoint attempted but arXiv cache returned Cache miss

title: Ontology-to-tools Compilation for Executable Semantic Constraint Enforcement in LLM Agents
exact_task: Compile ontology specifications into executable MCP-aware tools used by agents to extract, validate, repair and instantiate ontology-consistent knowledge graphs from scientific text.
model_scale: Primary abstract does not state a fixed model scale; LLM-based agents in The World Avatar proof-of-principle
runtime: Ontology-aware executable tools; MCP; persistent knowledge-graph state; structured constraint feedback
baselines: Proof-of-principle case study; no matched raw/teacher/compiled fixed-student interface contrast stated in primary abstract
data: Metal-organic polyhedra synthesis literature; ontology-constrained knowledge-graph construction
evaluation: Semantic constraint enforcement during generation; extraction/validation/repair case-study outcomes
distinction_from_flagship: Occupies formal semantics compiled into executable LLM tool interfaces. It targets constrained KG construction, not authoritative four-state query results rendered by a frozen small model with matched result-interface controls.
evidence: arXiv:2602.03439v1 abstract and Cambridge Technical Report 343 primary page retrieved 2026-08-07

title: LINC
exact_task: Translate natural-language logic problems into first-order logic and use a theorem prover for logical reasoning.
model_scale: Includes StarCoder+ 15.5B and proprietary GPT-family models reported by the paper
runtime: First-order theorem prover after LM semantic parsing
baselines: Direct language-model reasoning and neurosymbolic comparisons reported in the paper
data: ProofWriter, FOLIO and logical-reasoning benchmarks used by LINC
evaluation: Answer accuracy plus failure analysis of translation/proving pipeline
distinction_from_flagship: Shows a relatively small/open model can benefit from external formal proof, but does not compare raw/teacher/structured/executed result placements or preserve a four-state epistemic result frame.
evidence: ACL Anthology 2023.emnlp-main.313 primary paper; retrieved in WP-003 primary-source pass

title: Logic-LM
exact_task: Translate natural-language reasoning problems into symbolic formulations, execute a deterministic solver, and use solver feedback to refine formalization errors.
model_scale: GPT-3.5 family in the reported main experiments
runtime: Task-dependent symbolic solvers plus self-refinement loop
baselines: Standard prompting and chain-of-thought baselines plus solver-assisted variants
evaluation: Reasoning accuracy across five datasets; reported gains over direct/CoT prompting
distinction_from_flagship: Occupies symbolic formulation plus deterministic inference and solver-feedback correction, but not fixed-weight result-interface placement with independent layer oracle and strict four-state transport.
evidence: ACL Anthology 2023.findings-emnlp.248 primary paper; retrieved in WP-003 primary-source pass

title: Faithful Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
exact_task: Separate translation, deterministic task-specific symbolic solving and natural-language answer construction to improve faithfulness.
model_scale: Paper evaluates multiple GPT/Codex-family models; exact per-experiment models are retained in the primary paper rather than inferred here
runtime: Task-specific deterministic solvers between translation and answer construction
baselines: Standard CoT and decomposition/reasoning baselines reported by the paper
data: Multiple math, planning and symbolic-reasoning datasets
evaluation: Accuracy and faithfulness-related evaluation across tasks
distinction_from_flagship: Occupies translation-solve-render decomposition, but not a typed four-state epistemic result interface or matched structured/no-conclusion and answer-copying controls.
evidence: ACL Anthology 2023.ijcnlp-main.20 primary paper; exact PDF fields require primary-table reread before claim freeze

title: SatLM
exact_task: Generate a declarative satisfiability/theorem-proving specification from a problem and delegate solving to an automated theorem prover.
model_scale: Multiple GPT/Codex-family models reported; exact per-experiment model assignment retained in primary paper
runtime: Automated theorem prover over LM-generated declarative specification
data: Eight reasoning datasets reported by the paper
evaluation: Task accuracy; solver-side guarantees are conditional on the generated specification
distinction_from_flagship: Occupies declarative solver-aided reasoning and correctness relative to parsed specification; does not study semantic-result placement into a strict four-state renderer interface.
evidence: NeurIPS 2023 proceedings primary page and paper; exact model table to be refreshed before final claim freeze

title: Program-Aided Language Models
exact_task: Have the language model generate a program for a reasoning problem and execute it in Python to obtain the answer.
model_scale: Codex-family language model in the original PAL evaluation
baselines: Chain-of-thought and direct language-model reasoning baselines
data: 13 benchmark tasks including GSM8K and other numerical/symbolic tasks
evaluation: Task accuracy; GSM8K improvement over large-model CoT highlighted
distinction_from_flagship: Establishes execution-first program-aided reasoning, but not open-world four-state epistemic status preservation or a verified semantic-result frame consumed by a fixed small renderer.
evidence: ICML/PMLR 2023 PAL primary proceedings page and paper
